verses.text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth.

segments.text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth.

verses.text: O YHWH, I have heard the report of You; [and] I was afraid, O YHWH, of Your work. In the midst of the years may You revive it; in the midst of the years make [it] known; in wrath, may You remember to have compassion.

segments.text: O YHWH, I have heard the report of You; [and] I was afraid, O YHWH, of Your work. In the midst of the years may You revive it; in the midst of the years make [it] known; in wrath, may You remember to have compassion.

verses.text: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of His praise.

segments.text: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of His praise.

verses.text: And [His] brightness was like the light; rays [were] unto Him from His hand, and there [was] the hiding of his power.

segments.text: And [His] brightness was like the light; rays [were] unto Him from His hand, and there [was] the hiding of his power.

verses.text: Before His face went pestilence, and plague came forth at His feet.

segments.text: Before His face went pestilence, and plague came forth at His feet.

verses.text: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains were scattered, and the hills of old bowed; the ways of old [are] unto Him!

segments.text: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains were scattered, and the hills of old bowed; the ways of old [are] unto Him!

verses.text: Under affliction I have seen the tents of Cushan; the curtains of the land of Midian were trembling.

segments.text: Under affliction I have seen the tents of Cushan; the curtains of the land of Midian were trembling.

verses.text: Against the rivers did it burn, O YHWH—Your anger against the rivers? Or [was] Your wrath against the sea, when You rode on Your horses, Your chariots of salvation?

segments.text: Against the rivers did it burn, O YHWH—Your anger against the rivers? Or [was] Your wrath against the sea, when You rode on Your horses, Your chariots of salvation?

verses.text: Your bow was uncovered [with] nakedness speech was sworn [for] arrows. Selah With rivers You split the earth;

segments.text: Your bow was uncovered [with] nakedness speech was sworn [for] arrows. Selah With rivers You split the earth;

verses.text: the mountains saw You [and] trembled. A storm of waters passed by; the deep gave forth its voice, [and] on high its hand lifted.

segments.text: the mountains saw You [and] trembled. A storm of waters passed by; the deep gave forth its voice, [and] on high its hand lifted.

verses.text: The sun [and] moon stood still in its high place; at the light of Your arrows they went forth, at the brightness of the flashing of Your spear.

segments.text: The sun [and] moon stood still in its high place; at the light of Your arrows they went forth, at the brightness of the flashing of Your spear.

verses.text: In wrath You marched through the land, in anger You trampled the nations.

segments.text: In wrath You marched through the land, in anger You trampled the nations.

verses.text: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, for salvation with Your anointed; You struck the head of the house of the wicked, uncovering [him] from base to neck. Selah

segments.text: You went forth for the salvation of Your people, for salvation with Your anointed; You struck the head of the house of the wicked, uncovering [him] from base to neck. Selah

verses.text: You pierced the head of his warriors with his staves; they stormed out to scatter me, [in] their rejoicing as one who devours the afflicted in [his] hiding place.

segments.text: You pierced the head of his warriors with his staves; they stormed out to scatter me, [in] their rejoicing as one who devours the afflicted in [his] hiding place.

verses.text: You tread on the sea [with] Your horses, a surge of great waters.

segments.text: You tread on the sea [with] Your horses, a surge of great waters.

verses.text: I heard [it], and my belly trembled, my lips quivered at the sound; decay came into my bones, and from under me I trembled, that I might rest in the day of distress, to come upon the people who invade us.

segments.text: I heard [it], and my belly trembled, my lips quivered at the sound; decay came into my bones, and from under me I trembled, that I might rest in the day of distress, to come upon the people who invade us.

verses.text: Though the fig tree may not bud, and there be no fruit on the vines; though the work of the olive may fail, and the fields not produce food, though the flock is cut off from the fold, and there herd [is] in the stalls,

verses.text: yet I will exult in YHWH; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation.

segments.text: yet I will exult in YHWH; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation.

verses.text: YHWH the Lord is my strength, and He will make my feet like a deer’s, and on my high places He makes me tread. To the one directing: With stringed instruments.
